nav.title: The app map
nav.body: Here are the areas: Today (what matters now), Tasks, Finance and Home. Finance and Goals are optional: turn them on and off any time, nothing is lost.

reminder.title: Create your first reminder
reminder.body: A reminder arrives as an alert at the set time, for you or for the other person.

list.title: Your reminders live here
list.body: Everything set for today shows up in this list. When the time comes, you complete, snooze or cancel with one tap.

city.title: Is your city right?
city.body: It sets the time of your reminders and routine. If it is wrong, the 8am alert arrives at the wrong hour.

invite.title: Invite the other person
invite.body: Reminders, tasks and shopping are better together: what one person writes, the other sees. Until then, the app works for you alone.

push.title: Get alerts
push.body: Turn them on so reminders arrive on time, even with the app closed. Your browser will ask for permission.

end.title: All set!
end.body: Just use it now. What you agree on shows up in Today, and alerts arrive on time. To see the tour again, open the account menu.

invite.lead: Send this code to the other person. They paste it on the “Got an invite?” screen. It is valid for 7 days and only one person can use it.

push.done: Alerts turned on for this device.
